note: Iowa DNR recreation area of 544 acres of cottonwood woods in the Missouri River bottoms west of I-29 exit 72, next to DeSoto National Wildlife Refuge. One large, well-shaded campground of long back-in sites (45-70 ft), set back in the woods about 200 m from the river. Showers, flush toilets, dump station, playground; three youth-group areas. Missouri River boat ramp and dock; about five miles of trails; the area outside the campground is open to hunting in season. --Claude
summary: 50A electric (30 sites), 39 RV sites 45-70 ft (no pull-throughs), showers/flush/dump, 100% reservable confirmed; season set Apr 15-Oct 15 from ReserveAmerica. Fees $12/$16 non-electric (sites 45-65 ft fit) confirmed. Not waterfront confirmed (RA 'Near Water - no' on all; river ~200 m through woods). No flood or other closure posted. Pin ~360 m off the GIS centroid. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. ReserveAmerica tags all 42 units 'Near Water - no'. NAIP with the GIS points plotted puts the nearest sites (26-28) ~200-250 m from the Missouri River through unbroken cottonwood forest; the marshy backwater south-east of the campground is ~400 m from the southern sites. The DNR mentions a 'backwater chute' for fishing; no site is on it. Distances are imagery estimates; Overpass unavailable.

CLOSURE: none. No Wilson Island alert on the Iowa DNR park-alerts page (read 2026-11-03); ReserveAmerica shows only the seasonal 'Closed through Wed Apr 14 2027' and licence/hunting notes. Flooding history not researched beyond the current alerts.

SITES: stored 44 (note: 31 electric + 10 non-electric + 3 youth) vs ReserveAmerica's 30 electric + 9 non-electric + 3 youth = 42 bookable; GIS adds 039 and 041, which aren't bookable (probably host or staff sites). Count written as 39 RV sites.
PIN: stored 41.48911,-96.00963 is on the park road ~180 m east of site 1 and ~360 m from the GIS centroid. Suggest 41.4870,-96.0128 (GIS centroid; the campground runs 41.4818-41.4893 north-south).
